# 3D Rebuild Specification: Cartoon Doctor Character

## Overall Style
3D-rendered cartoon character (Pixar-like), bust/upper-body view, facing viewer, slightly angled. Soft studio lighting, smooth shading.

## Head & Face
- **Skin:** Light peach/tan tone (approx. #F5C9A6)
- **Hair:** Dark brown/black (#2B2320), styled short with a swept side part, some volume on top, neatly groomed
- **Eyes:** Large dark brown/black cartoon eyes with white highlights
- **Eyebrows:** Thick, dark brown, slightly raised — friendly look
- **Nose:** Small, rounded cartoon nose
- **Expression:** Warm, confident smile; closed-mouth or slight open smile showing friendliness; cheeks slightly rounded
- **Ears:** Visible on both sides, skin-toned

## Clothing
- **Coat:** White doctor's lab coat (#FFFFFF with light gray shading, #E8E8E8 shadows), open lapels, collar visible
- **Shirt:** Light blue dress shirt (#9FC5E8 / #A8CBE8) visible in the chest opening
- **Tie:** Blue tie (#3D6FB4 / medium blue), tied at the collar, hanging down the chest — slightly darker blue than the shirt
- **Pocket:** Chest pocket on viewer's left side of coat with what appears to be a pen/clipboard item

## Stethoscope
- **Tubes:** Dark gray/charcoal (#4A4A4A) tubing draped around the neck, hanging down both sides of the chest
- **Chest piece:** Silver/gray metallic diaphragm on the viewer's right side near the coat's lower edge
- **Earpieces:** At the neck/shoulder area

## Arms & Pose
- **Right arm (viewer's left):** Bent at elbow, hand raised in a thumbs-up gesture at chest height
- **Left arm (viewer's left of character):** Appears bent, hand possibly near chest/holding coat edge (partially obscured)
- Hands are skin-toned, cartoon-proportioned with rounded fingers

## Framing (head to waist)
- Visible from top of hair to approximately waist/hip level
- Crop ends just below the coat's lower button area

## Background
- Plain white/very light background (#FFFFFF), no props, no gradients — isolated character render
